venues.name: CC Atlanta
venues.weather: Mid 90s, hot and humid with stray storms
venues.narrative: **CCATL — Thursday 8/13** Strong start at +12.7% to target. A 15-person reservation (Kimberly Caroll) came in ready to eat and drink — Daisy de Sandia, Chennai Cobbler and Pink Flamingo were the popular picks; they closed out just before 8pm on a $874.47 subtotal. Meal Deals carried the food side: 16 sold and food sales already at $450 by 7pm. MOD supported the opener through the rush with the closing bartender and barback in at 6pm; BOH held it down and teamwork was good all around. A couple of long ticket times were handled with table touches and a comped digestif for the longest waits. Opener cut just before 8pm; barback knocked out batches. CO2 alarm went off and MOD used it as a teaching moment on loose keg enclosures. Flow quieted 6–7pm then picked back up 8–11pm with a steady trickle. Smooth last call, everyone out just after midnight. Maintenance: Easy Ice service request placed for the crushed ice machine (requested Ramen as the tech). 86: seasonal beer, carrots. Low: Sierra Pils, Fernet Branca. Favorite moment: regular Jay back in the space after months of travel. MOD: JK.

venues.name: CC Nashville
venues.weather: Very hot and humid; heavy foot traffic for the Riversteps concert
venues.narrative: **CCNSH — Thursday 8/13** Enormous night at +115% to target. The Riversteps concert on the property drove a wave of guests and then some — a reminder that property activations directly move the needle here. Decent outside sales and the party kept going inside: over $1,500 by 7pm and roughly $4k by 8:30pm, with most of the night's volume done in a short window. Volume held until 11pm and noticeably slowed around 11:30pm. Check averages ran lower than usual ($22.33) because guests kept closing out and cycling through. Kitchen did decent food sales though the team wished for more; JMS held down BOH and was present on the floor. Favorite moment: a visit from former teammate Margo with Edy — still remembered for her ABK skills and her contribution to the opening. MOD: KK/KE/MD, Chef JMS.

venues.name: D&C Denver
venues.weather: Overcast and drizzly most of the night
venues.narrative: **DVR — Thursday 8/13** Finished +2.1% to target despite weather that cut Garden business way short. DC/AM did $936.26 with steady business through the day, some IRDs sent up and cocktails dished out. D&C (PM) did $10,383.53 — the lobby was busy much of the night without quite going on a wait; rain pushed everyone indoors and the Garden closed early. A Queen City Sake Fest seminar in 6A brought about 20 people in. Garden/6A finished at $655.08 on a sleepy rainy night, closing down early and cutting the Banana Bash short. Kitchen ran slow with a pop at the end and very chill vibes. Comps $366.60 (~3.21%). Favorite moments: meeting two sake brewers in from Japan, something other than FroSpro on the Frosty Factory, and Carey in the banana costume. MODs: Chef Josh & Carey (AM), Evan (PM).

venues.name: D&C Los Angeles
venues.narrative: **LA — Thursday 8/13** Missed target by 23.4% on a quiet night. Steady groovy vibes all evening with three hosts on (Ariana and Analise in training) kept busy with cleaning and side projects. A few large groups made the room feel full for the first couple of hours but it never got completely full; a short waitlist of 4-tops all got seated and a few reservations no-showed. Streets were very quiet all night and the last two hours were dramatically slow — Edwin cut around 10:30pm, Xavier around 11:30pm. Julian handled the floor with ease for a smooth close; Natalie's host training wrapped and the team was out by 12:45am. Standing Room dark ($0); all sales through Marquee. Kitchen: shoutout to Oscar and Vic for service and prep, enchiladas for family meal plus a menu tasting for the new hosts. Maintenance: a few loose tiles by the host stand. 86: tuna crudo. MOD: Gigi, Chef Oscar.

venues.name: D&C Washington DC
venues.narrative: **DC — Thursday 8/13** Finished 34.3% under target. Promising start with a handful of groups arriving around 5:30 and a peak by 7pm, but the anticipated late-night rush never materialized — host cut at 9, first server at 10. Jada held the bar solo until Sophia joined around 6:30; Devan stepped in at 6:45 to help Tyler on the floor until Chaz arrived around 7:30. Point broke down around 11:15. A mini bar-top pop at 11:50 included former bartender Charles and his partner Star, and a natural last call landed at 12:30. Garden dark ($0). Guests: 77 total (32 reservations, 45 walk-ins). Comps $87.30 (industry $26.40, F&F $0.90, rang-wrong $60). Win of the night: Chaz's first solo closing server shift. To improve: use handhelds, run food. MOD: Marcus.

venues.name: Municipal Grand F&B
venues.weather: Very sunny and hot; afternoon storm with lightning
venues.narrative: **MG — Thursday 8/13** Finished 21.4% under target. Municipal Bar morning did $748 on 17 guests — very quiet, only two food tickets before 10am, with noon the busiest period; Sierra solo-served all of brunch with no tours and minimal beverages. Evening did $4,054 on 112 guests: a slower night with a lot of full dinners, so service was steady multi-course care. Ran with 1 host, 3 servers, a barback and 2 bartenders; Eryn out around 9pm, Jason around 10. Sun Club $135 — slow start, a rain storm with lingering lightning from 3–4pm, then dark clouds scared everyone off (needs lime and lemon tomorrow). Hot Eye $577 and a bit of a ghost town: a few early couples, a long lull, no foot traffic from the show, saved late by service industry and MG staff after Palm Wine. A large group of women came in and left almost immediately over the 'rotten' smell in THE and the connecting hallway. Kitchen: smooth service with a couple of good early pops. Maintenance: floors in THE. MODs: Justin (AM), Braden (PM); Chefs Lex & Drew.
